017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.commons.bean.*;
022
023/**
024 * Thrown when parser input (or the source map of a {@code Map}-to-bean conversion) does not contain one or more
025 * properties marked {@link BeanProp#required() @BeanProp(required=true)}.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * The check runs once per bean, after all input properties have been read and before the bean is constructed, so
029 * records and constructor-argument beans get this exception instead of a constructor failure.  An explicit
030 * <jk>null</jk> value counts as present.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * This is a {@link ParseException}, so REST {@code @Content} parameters map it to <c>400 Bad Request</c>.
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
036 * <p class='bjava'>
037 *    <jk>public record</jk> Person(<ja>@BeanProp</ja>(required=<jk>true</jk>) String <jv>name</jv>, Integer <jv>age</jv>) {}
038 *
039 *    <jk>try</jk> {
040 *       JsonParser.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>.read(<js>"{\"age\":30}"</js>, Person.<jk>class</jk>);
041 *    } <jk>catch</jk> (MissingRequiredPropertyException <jv>e</jv>) {
042 *       <jv>e</jv>.getBeanClass();       <jc>// Person.class</jc>
043 *       <jv>e</jv>.getPropertyNames();   <jc>// [name]</jc>
044 *    }
045 * </p>
046 *
047 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
048 *    <li class='ja'>{@link BeanProp#required()}
049 * </ul>
050 *
051 * @serial exclude
052 */
053@SuppressWarnings({
054   "java:S110" // Inherited hierarchy depth from ParseException; acceptable for a specific parse failure.
055})
056public class MissingRequiredPropertyException extends ParseException {
057
058   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
059
060   /**
061    * Throws this exception if the bean map is missing required properties.
062    *
063    * <p>
064    * Parser sessions call this through {@code ParserSession.checkRequired(BeanMap)}.  Conversion code that has no
065    * parser session passes <jk>null</jk>, which omits the input position from the message.
066    *
067    * @param <T> The bean type.
068    * @param session The current parser session, or <jk>null</jk> if not parsing.
069    * @param m The bean map to check.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
070    * @return The same bean map, for chaining.
071    * @throws MissingRequiredPropertyException If a required property was never written.
072    */
073   @SuppressWarnings({
074      "java:S1168" // Pass-through for chaining: returns the argument itself, so null in gives null out
075   })
076   public static <T> BeanMap<T> check(ParserSession session, BeanMap<T> m) {
077      if (m == null)
078         return null;
079      var missing = m.getMissingRequiredProperties();
080      if (! missing.isEmpty())
081         throw new MissingRequiredPropertyException(session, m.getMeta().getClassInfo().inner(), missing);
082      return m;
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * Finds a {@link MissingRequiredPropertyException} in the cause chain of a throwable.
087    *
088    * <p>
089    * Bean property setters wrap failures from nested conversions, so conversion code uses this to re-surface the
090    * original exception (which is a {@link ParseException} and maps to HTTP 400).
091    *
092    * @param t The throwable to inspect.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
093    * @return The first exception of this type in the chain (including <c>t</c> itself), or <jk>null</jk> if none.
094    */
095   public static MissingRequiredPropertyException find(Throwable t) {
096      for (var i = 0; t != null && i < 32; i++, t = t.getCause())
097         if (t instanceof MissingRequiredPropertyException e)
098            return e;
099      return null;
100   }
101
102   private final Class<?> beanClass;
103   private final String[] propertyNames;  // Array (not List) so the exception stays serializable.
104
105   /**
106    * Constructor.
107    *
108    * @param session The parser session, or <jk>null</jk>.  Used to add the input position to the message.
109    * @param beanClass The bean class.
110    * @param propertyNames The missing property names.
111    */
112   public MissingRequiredPropertyException(ParserSession session, Class<?> beanClass, List<String> propertyNames) {
113      super(session, "Missing required properties on bean class '%s': %s", beanClass.getSimpleName(), propertyNames);
114      this.beanClass = beanClass;
115      this.propertyNames = propertyNames.toArray(String[]::new);
116   }
117
118   /**
119    * Returns the bean class whose required properties were missing.
120    *
121    * @return The bean class.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
122    */
123   public Class<?> getBeanClass() { return beanClass; }
124
125   /**
126    * Returns the names of the missing required properties, in bean property order.
127    *
128    * @return An unmodifiable list.  Never <jk>null</jk> or empty.
129    */
130   public List<String> getPropertyNames() { return List.of(propertyNames); }
131}
